# Bandwise

> Bandwise runs typed decisions (yes or no, pick one, score against a rubric) on TypeSafe's System One models, starting with Jev. It turns each answer's confidence into an action per band: act on its own, send to a person, fall back to a default, or escalate to a larger LLM. It versions question sets, rolls them out in stages (shadow, controlled, full) and records what every run cost and saved against an LLM.

Bandwise is an independent product built on TypeSafe's System One models. It is not made or endorsed by TypeSafe.

The hosted cloud is in early access and its pricing is not public. The kit below is free and open source under Apache-2.0. Bandwise is headless first: the console, the `bandwise` CLI, the HTTP API and the MCP server share one set of operations.

## Docs

- [Docs home](https://docs.bandwise.dev): concepts, specs, templates and the API reference
- [Quickstart](https://docs.bandwise.dev/docs/quickstart): run a question set on your machine in local mode
- [CLI reference](https://docs.bandwise.dev/docs/cli)
- [Templates](https://docs.bandwise.dev/docs/templates): nine starting specs, each with example and borderline states
- [Agents and MCP](https://docs.bandwise.dev/docs/agents-and-mcp)
- [Docs for LLMs](https://docs.bandwise.dev/llms.txt)

## Kit

- [bandwise-kit on GitHub](https://github.com/glacer06/bandwise-kit): spec format, local runner, CLI, templates and a Claude Code skill that finds decisions in a repository
- [@bandwise/cli](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@bandwise/cli): `npx @bandwise/cli run --local spec.json state.json` runs a spec with fixture answers, no key and no network
- [@bandwise/core](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@bandwise/core): spec schema, compiler, confidence router, cost and savings math
- [@bandwise/templates](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@bandwise/templates): the template pack

## Site

- [Home](https://www.bandwise.dev/): how a decision flows, the savings calculator, templates and the early-access form
